subject: Invoice delivery & billing contact setup — email vs portal
messages:
From: Anna Bennett <anna.bennett@acme-corp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: acme-ap@acme-corp.com, pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood invoices — delivery preference and VAT info

Hi Soojin,

Quick question as we get set up for Redwood invoices: does Redwood deliver invoices via an AP portal only, or can we receive PDFs by email? Our AP team (acme-ap@acme-corp.com) prefers automated delivery to their portal, but Procurement would like a copy sent to pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com for tracking.

Also can you confirm the VAT number you use on invoices and whether you can include our PO number on the invoice PDF? I attached our PO for reference.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Bennett
Finance Manager — Acme Corp

Attachments: PO-98765.pdf (application/pdf, 214 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Bennett <anna.bennett@acme-corp.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood invoices — delivery preference and VAT info

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the note and for sending PO-98765. Short answers up front:
- We support both delivery methods: automated push to a customer AP portal (SFTP/API/EDI integrations) and emailed PDF invoices.
- We can include your PO number on the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata for portal ingestion.
- Redwood will list our UK VAT number on invoices to EU/UK customers; for US customers we include our tax ID. If you need a specific format for the VAT line, send a quick sample and we'll mirror it.

A couple of things to pick:
1) If Acme wants automated portal delivery, we need the technical contact + SFTP/HTTP endpoint details (or the vendor onboarding ticket id). That enables us to push PDFs and the machine-readable XML.
2) If you prefer email copies, confirm the single address (acme-ap@acme-corp.com) or whether Procurement should also get a copy.

I copied Vivek (billing ops) and Laura (AP integrations) to help with the setup and timeline. We typically allow a 30-day window to get portal delivery active; email delivery can be live immediately.

Which route would you like us to take? If portal, can you share the endpoint or vendor onboarding link. If email, I’ll add acme-ap@acme-corp.com and pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com to the delivery list.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Acme_invoice_requirements_v2.pdf (summary of file fields Redwood can populate)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood invoices — delivery preference and VAT info

Looping in a quick ops note so we pick the path with the best supportability:

- Portal (preferred for enterprise customers): Pros: durable ingestion, less chance of missed invoices, easier PO matching, audit logs. Cons: requires vendor onboarding and a one-time config. Typical lead time 1–3 weeks.
- Email (fastest to enable): Pros: instant, low friction. Cons: higher risk of mailbox-level misses and manual AP steps; we should enable delivery tracking/receipt confirmations.

Suggested default for Acme: enable emailed PDFs to acme-ap@acme-corp.com and pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com now so invoices flow immediately, and run portal onboarding in parallel. That minimizes billing disruption. Laura can own the onboarding ticket; Marissa please confirm if we need any SLA exception to include both addresses on invoices.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Billing & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> > A couple of things to pick:
> > 1) If Acme wants automated portal delivery, we need the technical contact + SFTP/HTTP endpoint details...
> > 2) If you prefer email copies, confirm the single address...

From: Anna Bennett <anna.bennett@acme-corp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: acme-ap@acme-corp.com, pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood invoices — delivery preference and VAT info

Thanks everyone — happy with Vivek's suggested approach. Please do the following:

1) Start emailing PDFs to acme-ap@acme-corp.com and pete.jenkins@acme-corp.com immediately (copy both on each sent invoice).
2) Begin vendor onboarding for portal delivery — Pete will provide the vendor onboarding ticket (he's cc'd).
3) On invoices please include the PO number (PO-98765) and our billing reference BL-ACME-22 in the invoice header.
4) VAT/tax: we are US-headquartered and want the tax ID present; leave VAT blank unless Redwood is charging VAT. If you intend to add VAT, include the VAT number field so we can route appropriately.

If you send the first emailed invoice as a test, we will confirm receipt in AP and flag any parsing issues.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Anna
